package.description: A very simplified free Python IDE for beginners

en-US.author: Wingware
en-US.description: A very simplified free Python IDE for beginners
en-US.longDescription: Wing 101 is a very simple free Python IDE designed for teaching beginning programmers. It omits most features found in Wing Pro.
en-US.name: Wing 101
en-US.releaseNotes:
Features

* Show PDF files rendered in the editor
* Have AI agents set a new program as main entry point and say how to start it
* Let AI agents set up run arguments and Python environments
* Run AI agents' debug_test apart from your own debug sessions and breakpoints
* Show Support+Upgrades reminders at most once a day, with the expiry date
* Add a Journal of work sessions to Tasks, exported with Export History
* Ask before Merge From Branch has the AI agent resolve conflicts
* Allow chained read-only commands and quoted grep regexes during a merge
* Name the sessions vcs_merge waited for in its result
* Ask in Make Tasks whether to save the plan's tasks as Drafts or run them now
* Share checklist steps whether or not Share Plan is on
* Choose which other developers' plans and checklists to show from filters
* Merge the Tasks Manager's repeated questions about a task into one
* Tell the Tasks Manager when you answer a task's questions yourself
* Let the Tasks Manager update the project's Claude Code memory
* Allow up to 32 writing workers in the Tasks Manager's settings
* Show the Tasks Manager's session when its state text is clicked
* Add Mark as New to task menus, to put a seen task back on Incoming
* Mark running tasks on Up Next with a Running pill, and their status Working
* Retitle Up Next's "Ready - Not Yet Queued" section as "Not Yet Queued"
* Show Perforce Blame as annotations in the editor, like Git and Mercurial
* Update bundled Python to 3.14.10 and OpenSSL to 3.5.9; drop revoked CAs

Bug Fixes

* Fix analysis memory growing without limit as files are scanned
* Fix editor pauses analyzing very large files or trimming the analysis cache
* Fix some analysis results not being saved to the analysis database
* Fix some inferred attributes going missing until their file is edited
* Fix files changed outside of Wing sometimes not being reanalyzed
* Fix macOS sometimes missing file edits made just after a folder is watched
* Fix "Analyzing Files: W=" staying on the status line after analysis ends
* Fix version control commands sometimes taking 3 seconds longer than needed
* Fix remote VCS commands sometimes failing right after files change
* Fix reviews of changes showing Read Failure or omitting removed files
* Fix stale-test detection missing tests right after an edit or a test run
* Fix test_get_details including output from other concurrent test runs
* Fix AI agent sessions restored at startup sometimes never getting tasks
* Don't submit a long half-typed agent prompt along with text Wing sends
* Don't wait at quit on an agent whose hooks never reached Wing
* Fix quoted or abbreviated VCS options escaping agent permission checks
* Don't let AI agents mistake edit_scope's own writes for another writer's
* Fix commits leaving out files a task changed after its turn ended
* Fix an agent's own hg or git commit marking all its task's files committed
* Fix Tasks Manager commits taking unfinished tasks' changes to shared files
* Fix the Tasks Manager failing to commit a merge a task made with hg merge
* Fix one-writer Tasks Manager starting tasks while work is uncommitted
* Don't ask the user to commit Tasks Manager work whose commit failed
* Don't report a task's work as lost when the task undid its own change
* Fix vcs_merge waiting on its own caller in a resumed agent session
* Let a resumed session finish its merge, or another take over a closed one's
* Don't block the Tasks Manager's non-VCS commands during a merge
* Fix losing a plan when Share Plan is changed in another working copy
* Fix Questions tab refilling a sent plan comment when a task asks again
* Don't let the Tasks Manager accept a plan while you work in its task's session
* Fix a Tasks Manager redirect sometimes taken as a prompt the user typed
* Fix the Tasks Manager's answers sometimes never reaching a task
* Keep a task taken out of plan mode out of it when Wing restarts
* Don't run a task alone when its text only mentions a later merge
* Let the Tasks Manager retire a superseded plan's Drafts it filed
* Don't show tasks the Tasks Manager makes Ready as new on Incoming
* Don't bring the AI Agent tool to the front when a queued task starts
* Keep the running time of Up Next's running tasks counting up
* Don't count time the machine slept in a task's running time
* Fix Tasks rows not updating after a menu choice until the pointer moves away
* Fix agent-filed task rows indenting further than others on the Tasks panel
* Drop the "- " before a task status that wraps below its name
* Fix the Tasks Manager's cog not matching the size of the text beside it
* Fix changes to the Interfaces path preference not fully taking effect
* Fix SSH passphrase prompts showing a key file's path lowercased on Windows
* Fix Peers Test Connection hanging when the remote agent is missing
* Fix peer messages queued at nearly the same time going out of order
* Fix Perforce commands using Wing's directory to find P4CONFIG files
* Fix Perforce commands doing nothing just after fixing its settings
* Fix overriding OpenCode permissions set in XDG_CONFIG_HOME on Windows
* Fix the Russian translation of the Running status in Tasks and Testing
* Fix the analysis helper cutting ide.log short and ignoring --settings
